item.title: I hate the PaperMod theme
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description:
HUGO is a brilliant framework for static websites, which allows you to build your own websites quickly and offers flexibility and ease of use. And do I hate the themes for it. Especially PaperMod, as I’ve used it myself.

PaperMod theme sucks. Easy to set up, but so fucking difficult to modify. Tons of CSS files that need to be overridden manually one by one. A lot of useless features, with very unreadable code. It provides a very streamlined experience, and sites using it look the same! I can see from a mile if a HUGO site is using this theme. On top of that, it’s bloated.

item.title: Boiling Point
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description:
This movie is very uncomfortable. I think it is the most dirty movie in the filmography of Takeshi Kitano that I have seen. It’s fascinating to watch it after having seen his later works, and it’s certainly something unique.

The film is divided into two parts. In the first part, we get a glimpse into our protagonist’s life, a shiftless guy called Masaki. This first half is very light-hearted, leading up to the main conflict. In the second half, shit gets real. The main characters meet Uehara, played by Takeshi himself.

item.title: Hard Boiled
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description:
A cool movie about cool guys. The action scenes are very well choreographed and take up most of the running time, which is definitely beneficial. What else would you expect from a John Woo movie?

Sliding on motorcycles, jumping and shooting with two pistols Max Payne style, an exploding fire extinguisher, a shotgun that blows up everything it hits. It’s the epitome of cool. There is a total of three locations where the action takes place, interspersed with explanations of the characters’ motivation and a bit of drama. There is a tea shop, a warehouse and, finally, a hospital. The action in the hospital goes on for a whole hour and is absolutely packed with cool scenes.

item.title: Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description: My fucking god, this game is so cool. It really draws you in, giving you an unforgettable experience. I can’t think of any other game that can evoke so many emotions in such a little timespan. Just three unforgettable hours of brutality, misery, loss, and a feeling of loneliness. I haven’t played the first instalment, Kane & Lynch: Dead Men, but I don’t think that has had much of an impact on my experience with the second one.

item.title: Crow Country
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description:
My disappointment of the year. This game was praised from every corner of the WWW, but after only 2 years, it appears that everyone has forgotten about it.

I want to start with the good, and the reason why I bought this game. Visuals. Finally, someone stopped jerking off to PlayStation 1 polygons and took the inspiration from N64. The visuals are very cute!

Unfortunately, the developers decided to fuck this up by making them low resolution. The beautiful models are smeared with a pixelation, the result of which is that you stop paying attention to the surroundings and everything turns into a pixelated mess if you play long enough.

item.title: Metal Gear
item.author: pivnoy_chel@pivnya.cool (pivnoy_chel)
item.description:
It’s a classic stealth action adventure that was ported to Steam in MGS Vol. 1 Collection in 2023. Despite that, this game was ported to nearly every console, except maybe PS2, LOL.

This time, Konami decided to get more money from gaijins by publishing it under the price tag on Steam. Perhaps gambling doesn’t give them enough money, and they decided to milk all of their franchises with re-releases and remasters. The same way they are raping the corpse of Silent Hill.
